40021724.author: पदार्थः
40021724.content: ततो then, रजन्यां night, व्युष्टायां having dawned, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a sorrowful mind, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, अब्रवीत् spoke, वाक्यं words, मुखेन with a face, परिशुष्यता drying up.

40021724.author: Translation
40021724.content: Then, when the night had dawned, Lakshmana, with a sorrowful mind and a parched face, spoke to Sumantra.

40021725.author: पदार्थः
40021725.content: सारथे O charioteer, तुरगान् horses, शीघ्रं quickly, योजयस्व harness, रथोत्तमे to the excellent chariot, स्वास्तीर्णं well-cushioned, राजभवनात् from the royal palace, सीतायाश्च and for Sita, आसनं seat, कुरु prepare.

40021725.author: Translation
40021725.content: O charioteer, quickly harness the horses to the excellent chariot and prepare a well-cushioned seat for Sita from the royal palace.

40021726.author: पदार्थः
40021726.content: सीता Sita, हि indeed, राजवचनात् by the king's command, आश्रमं to the hermitage, पुण्यकर्मणाम् of the virtuous ones, मया by me, नेया to be taken, महर्षीणां of the great sages, शीघ्रम् quickly, आनीयतां let it be brought, रथः the chariot.

40021726.author: Translation
40021726.content: Indeed, Sita is to be taken by me to the hermitage of the virtuous great sages by the king's command, so let the chariot be brought quickly.

40021727.author: पदार्थः
40021727.content: सुमन्त्रस्तु but Sumantra, तथा so be it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, युक्तं harnessed, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, रथं the chariot, सुरुचिरप्रख्यं appearing very beautiful, स्वास्तीर्णं well-cushioned, सुखशय्यया with a comfortable seat.

40021727.author: Translation
40021727.content: But Sumantra, having said "so be it," brought the chariot, harnessed with excellent horses, appearing very beautiful, and well-cushioned with a comfortable seat.

40021728.author: पदार्थः
40021728.content: आनीय having brought, उवाच said, सौमित्रिं to Lakshmana, मित्राणां of friends, मानवर्धनम् augmenter of honor, रथः chariot, अयं this, समनुप्राप्तो has arrived, यत् whatever, कार्यं task, क्रियतां let it be done, प्रभो O lord.

40021728.author: Translation
40021728.content: Having brought it, he said to Lakshmana, the augmenter of friends' honor, "O lord, this chariot has arrived; whatever task is to be done, let it be performed."

40021729.author: पदार्थः
40021729.content: एवमुक्तः thus addressed, सुमन्त्रेण by Sumantra, राजवेश्मनि in the royal palace, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रविश्य having entered, सीताम् Sita, आसाद्य having approached, व्याजहार spoke, नरर्षभः the best among men.

40021729.author: Translation
40021729.content: Lakshmana, the best among men, thus addressed by Sumantra, entered the royal palace, approached Sita, and spoke to her.

40021730.author: पदार्थः
40021730.content: त्वया by you, किल indeed, एषः this, नृपतिः king, वरम् a boon, वै indeed, याचितः was requested, प्रभुः the lord, नृपेण by the king, च and, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised, आज्ञप्तः I am commanded, च and, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, प्रति towards.

40021730.author: Translation
40021730.content: Lakshmana informed Sita that she had indeed requested a boon from the king, who in turn had promised it and now commanded Lakshmana to take her to a hermitage.

40021731.author: पदार्थः
40021731.content: गङ्गीतीरे on the bank of the Ganga, मया by me, देवि O Goddess, ऋषीणाम् of sages, आश्रमान् hermitages, शुभान् auspicious, शीघ्रम् quickly, गत्वा having gone, तु indeed, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, शासनात् by the command, पार्थिवस्य of the king, नः our, अरण्ये in the forest, मुनिभिः by sages, जुष्टे inhabited, अपनेया to be left, भविष्यसि you will be.

40021731.author: Translation
40021731.content: Lakshmana tells Sita that by the command of their king, he will quickly take her to the auspicious hermitages of sages on the bank of the Ganga, where she will be left in a forest frequented by ascetics.

40021732.author: पदार्थः
40021732.content: एवम् thus, उक्ता addressed, तु indeed, वैदेही Vaidehi, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना the great-souled, प्रहर्षम् great joy, अतुलम् incomparable, लेभे obtained, गमनम् the journey, च and, अपि also, अरोचयत् approved.

40021732.author: Translation
40021732.content: Thus addressed by the great-souled Lakshmana, Vaidehi felt incomparable joy and approved of the journey.

40021733.author: पदार्थः
40021733.content: वासांसि garments, च and, महार्हाणि valuable, रत्नानि jewels, विविधानि various, च and, गृहीत्वा having taken, तानि them, वैदेही Vaidehi, गमनाय for the journey, उपचक्रमे prepared.

40021733.author: Translation
40021733.content: Vaidehi, having taken valuable garments and various jewels, prepared herself for the journey.

40021734.author: पदार्थः
40021734.content: इमानि these, मुनिपत्नीनाम् to the wives of the sages, दास्यामि I shall give, आभरणान् ornaments, अहम् I, वस्त्राणि clothes, च and, महार्हाणि very valuable, धनानि riches, विविधानि various, च and,

40021734.author: Translation
40021734.content: I shall give these ornaments, very valuable clothes, and various riches to the wives of the sages.

40021735.author: पदार्थः
40021735.content: सौमित्रिस्तु But Lakshmana, तथा so be it, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, रथम् chariot, आरोप्य having made ascend, मैथिलीम् Maithili (Sita), प्रययौ proceeded, शीघ्रतुरगैः with swift horses, रामस्य of Rama, आज्ञाम् command, अनुस्मरन् remembering,

40021735.author: Translation
40021735.content: Lakshmana, having said "so be it," made Sita ascend the chariot and proceeded with swift horses, remembering Rama's command.

40021736.author: पदार्थः
40021736.content: अब्रवीत् said, च and, तदा then, सीता Sita, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् augmenter of prosperity, अशुभानि inauspicious signs, बहूनि many, एव indeed, पश्यामि I see, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus,

40021736.author: Translation
40021736.content: Then Sita said to Lakshmana, the augmenter of prosperity, "O delight of the Raghus, I indeed see many inauspicious signs."

40021737.author: पदार्थः
40021737.content: नयनम् eye, मे my, स्फुरति throbs, अद्य today, गात्रोत्कम्पः trembling of the body, च and, जायते occurs, हृदयम् heart, च and, एव indeed, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra, अस्वस्थम् uneasy, इव as if, लक्षये I perceive,

40021737.author: Translation
40021737.content: My eye throbs today, and a trembling of my body occurs; indeed, O son of Sumitra, I perceive my heart to be uneasy.

40021738.author: पदार्थः
40021738.content: औत्सुक्यम् anxiety, परमम् extreme, च and, अपि also, अधृतिः restlessness, च and, परा great, मम my, शून्याम् empty, एव indeed, च and, पश्यामि I see, पृथिवीम् the earth, पृथुलोचन O broad-eyed one,

40021738.author: Translation
40021738.content: I also have extreme anxiety and great restlessness, and indeed, O broad-eyed one, I see the earth as empty.

40021739.author: पदार्थः
40021739.content: अपि also, स्वस्ति welfare, भवेत् may there be, तस्य of him, भ्रातुः of brother, ते your, भ्रातृवत्सल O lover of brothers, श्वश्रूणाम् of mothers-in-law, च and, एव indeed, मे my, वीर O hero, सर्वासाम् of all, अविशेषतः especially, without exception, ...

40021739.author: Translation
40021739.content: Sita, addressing Lakshmana as a lover of brothers and a hero, wishes for the well-being of his brother (Rama) and especially for all her mothers-in-law.

40021740.author: पदार्थः
40021740.content: पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the kingdom, च and, एव indeed, कुशलम् welfare, प्राणिनाम् of living beings, अपि also, इति thus, अञ्जलिकृता with folded hands, सीता Sita, देवताः to the deities, अभ्ययाचत prayed, ...

40021740.author: Translation
40021740.content: With folded hands, Sita thus prayed to the deities for the well-being of all living beings in the city and the kingdom.

40021741.author: पदार्थः
40021741.content: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अर्थम् the request, ततः then, श्रुत्वा having heard, शिरसा with his head, वन्द्य having bowed to, मैथिलीम् Maithili, शिवम् auspicious, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, धृष्टः outwardly pleased, हृदयेन with a heart, विशुष्यता drying up, ...

40021741.author: Translation
40021741.content: Lakshmana, having heard Sita's request, bowed his head to Maithili and, though outwardly appearing pleased, said "auspicious" with a heart that was inwardly grieving.

40021742.author: पदार्थः
40021742.content: ततः then, वासम् dwelling, उपागम्य having reached, गोमतीतीरे on the bank of Gomati, आश्रमे in the hermitage, प्रभाते in the morning, पुनरुत्थाय having risen again, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, सूतम् to the charioteer, अब्रवीत् said, ...

40021742.author: Translation
40021742.content: Then, having stayed in a hermitage on the bank of the Gomati, Lakshmana rose again in the morning and spoke to the charioteer.

40021743.author: पदार्थः
40021743.content: योजयस्व harness, रथम् the chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, अद्य today, भागीरथीजलम् the water of the Bhagirathi, शिरसा with my head, धारयिष्यामि I shall bear, त्र्यम्बकः Tryambaka, पर्वते on the mountain, यथा just as, ...

40021743.author: Translation
40021743.content: Lakshmana instructed the charioteer to quickly harness the chariot, stating that he would bear the waters of the Bhagirathi on his head today, just as Lord Shiva bears them on the mountain.

40021744.author: पदार्थः
40021744.content: सः he, अश्वान् horses, रज्वा with reins, अथ then, चतुरः four, रथे to the chariot, युङ्क्त्वा having yoked, मनोजवान् swift as mind, आरोहस्व please ascend, इति thus, वैदेहीं to Vaidehi, सूतः the charioteer, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, अब्रवीत् said.

40021744.author: Translation
40021744.content: The charioteer Sumantra, having yoked four mind-swift horses to the chariot, then respectfully requested Vaidehi to ascend it.

40021745.author: पदार्थः
40021745.content: सा she, तु indeed, सूतस्य of the charioteer, वचनात् from the words, आरुरोह ascended, रथोत्तमम् the excellent chariot, सीता Sita, सौमित्रिणा with Lakshmana, सार्धम् together with, सुमन्त्रेण with Sumantra, च and, धीमता intelligent.

40021745.author: Translation
40021745.content: Sita, in response to the charioteer's words, ascended the excellent chariot accompanied by Lakshmana and the intelligent Sumantra.

40021746.author: पदार्थः
40021746.content: आससाद reached, विशालाक्षी the wide-eyed one, गङ्गां Ganga, पापविनाशिनीम् the destroyer of sins, अथ then, अर्धदिवसम् half a day, गत्वा having gone, भागीरथ्याः of Bhagirathi, जलाशयम् the body of water.

40021746.author: Translation
40021746.content: After traveling for half a day, the wide-eyed Sita reached the sacred waters of the Ganga, the destroyer of sins.

40021747.author: पदार्थः
40021747.content: निरीक्ष्य having seen, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनः distressed, प्ररुरोद wept loudly, महास्वनः with a great sound.

40021747.author: Translation
40021747.content: Observing the situation, the distressed Lakshmana wept loudly with a great sound.

40021748.author: पदार्थः
40021748.content: सीता Sita, तु but, परमायत्ता greatly agitated, दृष्ट्वा having seen, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, आतुरम् distressed, उवाच said, वाक्यं words, धर्मज्ञा knower of dharma, किम् what, इदम् this, रुद्यते is being wept, त्वया by you.

40021748.author: Translation
40021748.content: But Sita, a knower of dharma and greatly agitated upon seeing Lakshmana distressed, asked him, "Why are you weeping like this?"

40021749.author: पदार्थः
40021749.content: जाह्नवीतीरम् the bank of the Ganga, आसाद्य having reached, चिराभिलषितम् long-desired, मम my, हर्षकाले at the time of joy, किमर्थम् why, माम् me, विषादयसि you make sad, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana.

40021749.author: Translation
40021749.content: O Lakshmana, why do you make me sad at this joyful moment, when we have reached the bank of the Ganga, which I have desired for so long?

40021750.author: पदार्थः
40021750.content: नित्यम् always, त्वम् you, रामपार्श्वेषु by Rama's side, वर्तसे you remain, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, कच्चित् I hope, विनाकृतः separated, तेन by him, द्विरात्रम् for two nights, शोकम् sorrow, आगतः you have come.

40021750.author: Translation
40021750.content: O best among men, you are always by Rama's side; I hope you have not become sorrowful because you have been separated from him for two nights.

40021751.author: पदार्थः
40021751.content: ममापि even to me, दयितः dear, रामः Rama, जीवितादपि even more than life, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, न च and not, अहम् I, एवम् thus, शोचामि grieve, मा एवम् do not thus, त्वम् you, बालिशः childish, भव be.

40021751.author: Translation
40021751.content: O Lakshmana, Rama is dearer to me even than my own life, yet I do not grieve in this manner, so do not be childish.

40021752.author: पदार्थः
40021752.content: तारयस्व make me cross, च and, माम् me, गङ्गाम् the Ganga, दर्शयस्व show me, च and, तापसान् the ascetics, ततः then, मुनिभ्यः to the sages, दास्यामि I will give, वांसासि clothes, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.

40021752.author: Translation
40021752.content: Please ferry me across the Ganga and show me the ascetics, and then I will give clothes and ornaments to the sages.

40021753.author: पदार्थः
40021753.content: ततः then, कृत्वा having done, महर्षीणाम् of the great sages, यथार्हम् appropriately, अभिवादनम् salutation, तत्र there, च and, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, उष्य having stayed, यास्यामः we will go, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, पुनः again.

40021753.author: Translation
40021753.content: Then, after appropriately saluting the great sages and staying there for one night, we will return to that city (Ayodhya) again.

40021754.author: पदार्थः
40021754.content: ममापि my also, पद्मपत्राक्षं one whose eyes are like lotus leaves, सिंहोरस्कं one whose chest is like a lion's, कृशोदरम् one with a slender belly, त्वरते hastens, हि indeed, मनो mind, द्रष्टुं to see, रामं Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, वरम् the best.

40021754.author: Translation
40021754.content: My mind also indeed yearns to see Rama, who has eyes like lotus leaves, a lion-like chest, a slender belly, and is the best among those who delight others.

40021755.author: पदार्थः
40021755.content: तस्याः her, तद्वचनं that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रमृज्य having wiped, नयने eyes, शुभे beautiful, नाविकानाह्वयामास called the boatmen, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परवीरहा destroyer of enemy heroes.

40021755.author: Translation
40021755.content: Having heard her words and wiped his beautiful eyes, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, called the boatmen.

40021756.author: पदार्थः
40021756.content: इयं this, च and, सज्जा ready, नौः boat, च and, इति thus, दाशाः the boatmen, प्राञ्जलयो with folded hands, अब्रुवन् said.

40021756.author: Translation
40021756.content: The boatmen, with folded hands, said, "This boat is ready."

40021757.author: पदार्थः
40021757.content: तितीर्षुः desiring to cross, लक्ष्मणो Lakshmana, गङ्गां the Ganga, शुभां auspicious, नावं boat, उपारुहत् boarded, गङ्गां the Ganga, सन्तारयामास caused to cross, लक्ष्मणस् Lakshmana, तां her (Sita), समाहितः attentively.

40021757.author: Translation
40021757.content: Desiring to cross the Ganga, Lakshmana boarded the auspicious boat and then attentively ferried Sita across the Ganga. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 46 ।। Thus ends the forty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
